holdout.dedup: exact text keep smallest numeric ID
holdout.rule: rank exactly as experiment002; reserve first5000(language) as old diagnostic set; new test ranks5000..9999 zero-based
holdout.source: same pinned Tatoeba CC0 snapshot as002; distinct sentence IDs/texts, correlated source/templates; not new-domain independence

tokenization: same fixed tokenizer and wrong generation as experiment002; case preserved; >=4 decision gate
model: original experiment001 train only, no algorithm or parameter changes

morphology.engine: installed Hunspell1.7.5 C API spell only; UTF-8; no suggestions/analyze/generation
morphology.full: original pinned aff+dic; native case and flags retained
morphology.control: same dic and aff with all PFX/SFX directive rows removed; other directives, case and compound rules preserved
morphology.warning: control still has case, compounds and other semantics; call it noPfxSfx, not no-morphology

rules.exact: observed hit Keep; else alternative hit Correct; else Abstain
rules.fallback: exact decision unless Abstain; then twoScore
rules.confirmation: observed hit Keep; otherwise Correct only if alt hit and twoScore Correct; otherwise Abstain

ambiguity: union of stem-both, noPfxSfx-both, full-morph-both on actual case-preserved candidate pair; use same label for every method; any Correct unsafe, never recovered; separately show raw valid change totals

hypotheses.M1: full affix engine improves correct-word acceptance/recovery over noPfxSfx control; count added false changes
hypotheses.M2: morphFull closes recovery gap to compact twoScore without extra unsafe changes; explicit paired deltas
hypotheses.M3: twoScore confirmation reduces morphFull unsafe changes at recovery cost
hypotheses.M4: morphThenModel still adds useful OOV recovery; quantify unsafe additions

challenge: same original fixtures and noise sequence as002 (exclude old full stem lexicons only, not new morph acceptance); same645 cases; also report new morph ambiguity labels; do not choose new negatives using test results
metrics: occurrences plus exact case-preserved unique types for all methods (Hunspell case semantics); not directly comparable to002 canonical-folded types; language/length; word acceptance and pairwise changes vs control, stems, model, morph; full coverage denominators and unsafe counts; illustrative PPV at0.1%,1%,5% wrong prevalence
resources: fresh probe pair of full Hunspell engines using only approved aff/dic; no corpus/model/train lists; actual child RSS and load wall, warm uncached membership, explicit .aff+.dic and shared-lib sizes; no expansion to all forms
decision: no system input; no threshold or exception tuning after viewing new block; supported/refuted/inconclusive for each hypothesis only on sample; no world novelty or deployment safety claims
